test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The surveyor wrote a report on the property after doing an __on-field evaluation.__
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4: on-site assessment".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of a property surveyor, the more common term used is **"on-site assessment"** instead of "on-field evaluation".
 
• **"On-site" **typically refers to a location that is specific, usually where the said property is situated.
 
• The term** "assessment" **is used more commonly in relation to surveys and reports, specifically when evaluating something's value or worth.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is *"Option 4: on-site assessment".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• An **"official collection"** would not be an appropriate substitution as it does not convey the action of evaluating and assessing a property.
 
• An** "off-site assignment" **suggests an activity occurring away from the primary location, typically a workplace or site, which does not maintain the original meaning of the phrase to be replaced.
 
• **"Off-field tracking"** does not maintain the evaluative aspect of the surveyor's actions described in the original sentence.
